description: This file defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables and creates a scoped Vitest configuration for memory extension testing, exporting the default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include file patterns from environment variables, with fallback to an environment object parameter.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMemoryVitestConfig( createExtensionMemoryVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for extension memory testing, using patterns loaded from environment or default roots.
